2707-3617-7817.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Paradox Shaper by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Walk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

719-2511-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-2511-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat from step 3.

147-4452-8198.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Trystan's Command
147-4452-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Trystan's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Trystan's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4452-8198.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

687-4050-4613-8130-8132.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three additional counters of any kind on Tayam and/or additional creatures you control.
687-4050-4613-8130-8132.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Easterling Vanguard, adding mana.
When Easterling Vanguard dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate [[Tayam]] by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, milling three cards and returning Easterling Vanguard from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability again, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter and a -0/-1 counter from the creature token and a vigilance counter from Easterling Vanguard.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Easterling Vanguard and the creature token, adding mana.
When Easterling Vanguard dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three cards and returning Easterling Vanguard from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.
687-4050-4613-8130-8132.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

1734-5987-8095.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3327-3899-4549.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
3327-3899-4549.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

2921-7388--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

3184-4050-4766--190.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature, adding one mana of any color.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

225-907-1170-7529.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {1}{G}. 
Cast the copy of Rampant Growth from exile by paying {1}{G}, unpreparing Studious First-Year.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year, which enters prepared.
Resolve Rampant Growth, fetching a basic land from your library to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2082-2438-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2082-2438-3490-7426.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1818-3490-4017-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-3490-4017-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1978-3717-5056.description:
Cause Viridian Joiner to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat from step 2.

1781-1978-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 3 or greater.
1781-1978-6478.description:
Cause Arbor Adherent to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat from step 2.

803-4508-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
803-4508-6847.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1580-4871-5334-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4636-4772-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating six 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers six times, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a memory counter on it

851-3951-5703-6646.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
851-3951-5703-6646.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1287-4918-6320-6441.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1287-4918-6320-6441.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create two token copies of Aethertide Whale with haste.
When the Aethertide Whale tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1308-2457-4289-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

628-2438-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2438-5490.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1348-3181.notablePrerequisites:
Krosan Restorer does not have summoning sickness.
You control a mana-producing land.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1348-3181.description:
Declare Krosan Restorer as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, targeting Krosan Restorer.
Resolve the Maze of Ith ability, untapping Krosan Restorer and preventing all combat damage dealt to and by it this turn.
Activate Krosan Restorer's second ability by tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and any other land you control.
Activate a mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

500-4867-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instand and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Cabal Ritual and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
If you have seven or more cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite mana.

1064-4702-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Born to Drive attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1064-4702-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate Devoted Druid by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Optionally, you may use the mana abilities of the Devoted Druid tokens to add infinite {G}.

38-4763-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Skirk Prospector.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Koll triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying {R}.
Repeat.

238-2506-5147.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
238-2506-5147.description:
Cast Gerrard either from your graveyard or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Gerrard enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Gerrard with haste.
Put the nontoken Gerrard into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The nontoken Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the token Gerrard.
The token Gerrard dies, exiling itself and returning the nontoken Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).
